name: Northern Irish Open 2013

venue.name: Ballymoney Town Hall
venue.address: Townhead Street, Ballymoney, County Antrim, Northern Ireland, BT53 6BE.

information: Registration will open at 6pm on 18th January and will close on 17th March or when the competitor limit of 30 is reached. The competition is open to anyone. Registration fee will be £14 for 2 days, or £7 for one day.
